name: Fix Order Total Calculation
description: The `calculate_order_total` function has a bug: when a discount code is applied, the `discount_pct` (e.g., 10 for 10%) is multiplied directly against the subtotal instead of being divided by 100 first. Fix the bug. IMPORTANT: orders without a discount code must continue to work exactly as before — this is a regression test.
visible_hint: An order of 3 × $10 widgets with no discount and 0% tax should total $30.00
